//! Verifies the signed session tokens issued by this project's identity service. Generated by Tessery.

use base64::Engine;
use base64::engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD;
use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};
use sha2::Sha256;

/// The signed-in user. Handlers you write can read the email, role and expiry too.
#[allow(dead_code)]
pub struct Session {
    pub sub: String,
    pub email: String,
    pub role: String,
    pub exp: i64,
}

fn decode(s: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(s.trim_end_matches('=')).ok()
}

pub fn verify(token: &str) -> Option<Session> {
    let secret = std::env::var("AUTH_SECRET").ok().filter(|s| !s.is_empty())?;
    let mut parts = token.split('.');
    let (head, body, sig) = (parts.next()?, parts.next()?, parts.next()?);
    if parts.next().is_some() {
        return None;
    }
    let mut mac = Hmac::<Sha256>::new_from_slice(secret.as_bytes()).ok()?;
    mac.update(format!("{head}.{body}").as_bytes());
    mac.verify_slice(&decode(sig)?).ok()?;
    let claims: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_slice(&decode(body)?).ok()?;
    let exp = claims.get("exp").and_then(|v| v.as_i64().or_else(|| v.as_f64().map(|f| f as i64)))?;
    let now = std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok()?.as_secs() as i64;
    if exp < now {
        return None;
    }
    let field = |k: &str| claims.get(k).and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("").to_owned();
    Some(Session { sub: field("sub"), email: field("email"), role: field("role"), exp })
}

/// Reads `Authorization: Bearer ...` or the `session` cookie from the raw header values.
pub fn from_headers(authorization: Option<&str>, cookie: Option<&str>) -> Option<Session> {
    if let Some(token) = authorization.and_then(|a| a.strip_prefix("Bearer ")) {
        return verify(token);
    }
    cookie?.split(';').find_map(|part| part.trim().strip_prefix("session=")).and_then(verify)
}
